verdict.rationale: Yapily's own REST API lets a programmatic agent start authorisation flows (link sessions), retrieve accounts, balances and transactions under a consent token, and re-authorise consents. However, its MCP surface only connects agents to the documentation, not to platform operations. Authentication is HTTP Basic with the application ID and secret, with no documented scoped or least-privilege credentials. Missing for 10: an operational MCP server, scoped or least-privilege API credentials, documented connection/consent listing and revocation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate the platform — create link sessions, retrieve balances and transactions, and manage connections through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials
